steps.title: Confirm scope and inputs in Confluence
sop: Open Confluence and confirm the in-scope accounts and period for scope FinOps maturity assessment.
Check the control, owner, status, and evidence link fields are present and current.
Flag any missing account, feed, or field before starting.
Done when scope, period, and inputs are confirmed.
verify: Re-inspect the confirmed scope in Confluence.
Pass when in-scope accounts, period, and key fields are complete.

steps.title: Extract FinOps controls and policy artefacts from Confluence
sop: Query Confluence for FinOps controls and policy artefacts covering the period.
Apply account, service, and tag filters to the extract.
Stage the filtered extract for processing.
Done when the source extract is staged.
verify: Compare extract coverage to the expected account list.
Pass when every in-scope account appears in the extract.

steps.title: Scope FinOps maturity assessment in Confluence
sop: Plan and scope the FinOps maturity assessment against an industry framework such as the FinOps Foundation model using Confluence.
Apply the approved FinOps method and current period inputs.
Capture intermediate working in Confluence for review.
Done when scope is defined.
verify: Review the Confluence output against the intended result.
Pass when scope is defined.

steps.title: Validate results against recorded control evidence
sop: Reconcile the output totals to recorded control evidence.
Investigate any variance outside the agreed tolerance.
Confirm required coverage or record counts are met.
Done when the output reconciles within tolerance.
verify: Recompute the variance against recorded control evidence.
Pass when the variance is within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Log exceptions in Confluence
sop: Raise a Confluence record for each unresolved exception.
Attach the supporting evidence and the spend or coverage impact.
Assign an owner and a target resolution date.
Done when every exception has a ticket and an owner.
verify: List open exceptions and their Confluence tickets.
Pass when no exception is without a ticket and owner.

steps.title: Record evidence in Confluence
sop: Save the scope FinOps maturity assessment output and working to Confluence.
Tag the record with the period, version, and timestamp.
Link the evidence from the FinOps runbook.
Done when versioned evidence is stored and linked.
verify: Open the stored record in Confluence.
Pass when the evidence carries period, version, and timestamp.

steps.title: Update the FinOps reporting view in Confluence
sop: Refresh the Confluence view with the latest scope FinOps maturity assessment output.
Confirm metrics and filters render for stakeholders.
Remediate any stale tile or broken filter.
Done when the view reflects the current output.
verify: Open the Confluence view and check the refresh time.
Pass when the view shows current-period data.

steps.title: Sign off scope FinOps maturity assessment in the GRC platform
sop: Review the completed scope FinOps maturity assessment output and its evidence.
Confirm reconciliation, coverage, and exceptions are cleared.
Record sign-off with name and date in the GRC platform.
Done when scope is defined and sign-off is recorded.
verify: Check the sign-off entry in the GRC platform.
Pass when a dated sign-off by the FinOps Lead is present.
